project.name: Clunk
project.summary: An open-source WebMCP repair bench where a person supplies physical observations and an AI navigates source-backed appliance checks, highlights the physical location, and resolves an exact seller link when compatibility evidence is complete.
project.ai_usage: A compatible browser agent discovers supported appliances and invokes a state-dependent set of eight WebMCP tools against deterministic page state. The shipped site does not call a model. Lovable is used for hosting and GitHub sync.
project.codex_usage: Codex supported scoping, implementation, debugging, accessibility, deterministic testing, live browser verification, and open-source and Devpost documentation.

required_external_steps: Run and record the real-agent evaluation matrix
Publish a public YouTube demo under three minutes with audio
Choose submitter type, country, app status, learning level, and career-value answers
